description: Map fuzzy geography to concrete region codes. Filter by continent (NA/EU/AS/...), country, or 'near' a place (e.g. near='Singapore' returns nearby regions across all clouds, sorted by distance). Use this to turn 'near Singapore' / 'North America' into regions, then pass those to the price tools.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, JP, SG

limit.description: max regions to return (default and cap 50)

near.description: free-text place; returns regions near it sorted by distance, e.g. Singapore

name: list_regions
title: Find regions by geography
